settingsLanguageHelp: Izinguquko zolimi zisebenza kusixhumi esibonakalayo. Izimpendulo zemodeli zincike emiyalweni yakho nezilimi ezisekelwa imodeli ekhethiwe.

dependencySomeCoreBackendFilesAreMissing: Amanye amafayela angemuva abalulekile awatholakali noma onakele — lokhu ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi ukulanda kuphazanyisiwe noma ingobo yomlando ikhishwe kancane. Susa ingemuva futhi uyilande kabusha kokuthi Novera izilungiselelo.
dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Faka i-NCCL kusukela NVIDIA kusayithi likanjiniyela. I-NCCL isetshenziselwa ukuxhumana okuningi-GPU.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Faka i-NCCL ngendawo yephakheji ye-NVIDIA. Ku-Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Bona umhlahlandlela wokufaka we-NVIDIA NCCL we-distro yakho.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Faka i-cuDNN kusukela NVIDIA Isayithi likanjiniyela bese ubeka ama-DLL eceleni kohlelo lokusebenza noma kokuthi System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Faka i-cuDNN usebenzisa inqolobane yephakheji ye-NVIDIA noma landa i-tarball bese ukopisha ama-libs kokuthi /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Faka Vulkan Isikhathi sokusebenza kusuka ku-LunarG. Umshayeli wakho we-GPU kungenzeka ukuthi usevele uyifakile — buyekeza umshayeli wakho we-GPU kuqala.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Faka isilayishi se-Vulkan: ku-Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. Ku-Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. Ngo-RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.

dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit11FromNvi: Faka i-Toolkit ye-CUDA 11 evela ku-NVIDIA. Ngesikhathi sokufaka, khetha izingxenye ze-"CUDA".

dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Faka i-Toolkit ye-CUDA 12 kusuka ku-NVIDIA. Ngesikhathi sokufaka, khetha izingxenye ze-"CUDA".
Faka i-Toolkit ye-CUDA 12 kusuka ku-NVIDIA. Ku-Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Ku-RHEL/Fedora: sebenzisa i-repo ye-NVIDIA.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit13FromNvi: Faka i-Toolkit ye-CUDA 13 kusuka ku-NVIDIA. Ngesikhathi sokufaka, khetha izingxenye ze-"CUDA".
Faka i-Toolkit ye-CUDA 13 kusuka ku-NVIDIA. Ku-Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-13. Ku-RHEL/Fedora: sebenzisa i-repo ye-NVIDIA.
